return [{ json: { options: item.cached, source: 'cache' } }];

message.content: You look up real tile products sold in Australia and report their current listed price. Use web search. Only report products you can see on a retailer page. Never estimate, never invent a price. Prefer returning 1–3 real matches over an empty list. Reply with raw JSON only, no markdown: {"products":[{"name":..,"sizeMm":..,"finish":..,"price":..,"priceUnit":"sqm"|"box"|"piece","boxCoverageSqm":..,"retailer":..,"url":..}]}
